definitions.explanation: User interaction with content, measured through likes, comments, shares, and other actions.
Employee commitment and emotional connection to their work and organization.

⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧エンゲージメント⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エンゲージメント⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: engagement rate (sense 1)
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧エンゲージメント: employee engagement (sense 2)
- エンゲージメント⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to raise engagement

USAGE:
Both senses are business jargon. In sense 1 it is measured by likes, comments, and shares; in sense 2 it is linked to lower staff turnover ({離職率|りしょくりつ}) and higher productivity.

WATCH OUT:
エンゲージ⟦リング→リング：28765_ringu⟧ 'engagement ring' comes from the same English word but belongs to a different field; the everyday word for it is ⟦{婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}→婚約指輪：19305_konyakuyubiwa⟧.
